info.title: Vietnam Weather API
info.description: Provider-neutral Phase 5 weather contract. Public values use fixed metric SI-oriented units; raw provider payloads are never part of this API.

get.description: Returns separate account, entitlement, provider-valid and operational ceilings. No CSRF token is required for this read-only operation.

post.description: Treat this POST as a protected mutation: require an authenticated cookie, an exact allowlisted Origin header and a valid CSRF header. A provider-backed request returns success, pending, degraded or unavailable within the API timeout boundary.

200.description: Complete or explicitly degraded normalized weather.

202.description: The durable provider-backed query is still pending.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds before repeating the same request.

503.description: No weather is displayable inside the approved stale window.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds before repeating the same request.

cookieAuth.name: __Host-vnwa_session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session cookie.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly match a configured application origin.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Signed CSRF token bound to the authenticated browser flow.

InvalidRequest.description: Request shape or values are invalid.

AuthenticationRequired.description: A valid authenticated session is required.

MutationForbidden.description: The Origin is not allowlisted or CSRF validation failed.

LocationNotFound.description: The canonical target cannot be resolved.

RateLimited.description: The stable rate limit was exceeded.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds before repeating the same request.

UtcDateTime.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp normalized to UTC.

WeatherUnits.description: The fixed metric SI-oriented unit set for every public v1 weather value.

provider.description: Public source name, never a provider endpoint or credential.

WeatherQuality.description: Missing measurements remain null and are named here; zero is never a missing-value sentinel.

WeatherProvenance.description: Provider-issued time is nullable and is never inferred from fetchedAt.

WeatherFreshness.description: Stale data may be displayable but is not eligible for risk or route decisions.

WeatherFeatureCapability.description: effectiveMaximumHorizonHours is the minimum valid account, entitlement, provider and operational ceiling.

WeatherQueryTarget.description: Exactly one canonical locationId or coordinate pair. Coordinates are never echoed in errors.

ResolvedWeatherTarget.description: A coordinate query is resolved without returning the submitted coordinates.

DailyWeatherValue.description: One-day forecast interval in the canonical product timezone.

WeatherDegradedIssue.description: A stable, sanitized issue. It never contains coordinates, provider URLs or raw provider messages.

WeatherQueryPendingResponse.description: The caller may repeat the same query after the bounded retry delay.

WeatherError.description: Stable public error without coordinates, request payloads, provider endpoints, credentials or raw provider messages.
